_about: Switches you can change on-site; restart the server after editing. Only the keys written here override the defaults in backend/app/core/settings.py. sample_case: lines for the labelled sample ('Rx:' = from a prescription); its matches and findings are computed live. welcome_pairs: brand pairs the welcome screen shows first (from the story); each pair is checked in the registry and left out if the two do not share an ingredient.
